# Security Policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/Abhishek-Mallick/Isometric/security/advisories/new), not in public issues.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours and to ship a fix or mitigation as soon as possible. Isometric is distributed as source through the shadcn CLI, so fixes land in the registry and you receive them by re-running `npx shadcn@latest add`.
